item.title: Musicians Who Have Opened Up About Their Mental Health Struggles
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this special episode, where we're shining a light on mental health awareness in the music industry. For too long, musicians have struggled in silence, hiding their battles with mental health issues behind a mask of happiness. But times are changing, and many artists are now using their platforms to speak out and break the stigma.
[Soft music transitions in]
Host: Artists like Adele and Alanis Morissette have shared their experiences with postpartum depression, while Billie Eilish has opened up about how fame led to depression and suicidal thoughts. Bebe Rexha and Halsey have also spoken about their bipolar disorder diagnoses. Even rockstars like Duff McKagan from Guns N' Roses have shared their struggles with panic disorder.
[Music transitions to a more uplifting tone]
Host: These brave artists are using their voices to encourage their fans to prioritize their own mental well-being. And it's working. More and more people are feeling comfortable talking about their mental health journeys. As Chappell Roan said in her 2025 Grammys acceptance speech, it's time for us to come together and support each other's mental health.
[Music transitions back to a softer tone]
Host: May is Mental Health Awareness Month, and October 10th is World Mental Health Day. If you or someone you know is struggling, there is help available. You can call the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration's national helpline at 1-800-662-HELP, or text the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988 to connect with trained counselors.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks for tuning in to this important conversation. Remember, mental health matters, and you're not alone. Take care of yourself, and let's break the stigma together.
